create_ranked_logger: create a RankedLogger instance with a custom name and optional rank_zero_only flag
log_ranked_message: log a message with the current process rank prefixed to the log output
log_rank_zero_only: log a message that only outputs on the rank zero process in multi-GPU setups
log_to_specific_rank: log a message that only outputs on a specific rank by passing the rank parameter
review_ranked_logger_class: review the RankedLogger class and its multi-GPU-friendly logging capabilities
